home.heroSubtitle: An amateur sports club teaching the Vietnamese martial art of Binh Dinh Gia across the country. Register online for the {{season}} season.
home.aboutBody: Our clubs train athletes of every age in Binh Dinh Gia, a traditional Vietnamese martial art, under the Ministry of Youth and Sports and the wilaya directorates. Registration is open to seniors, veterans, and youth categories alike.
home.categoriesSubtitle: Every candidate is automatically placed in the correct category from their date of birth.
home.requirementsBody: Personal details, a few identity documents (set by the club — shown to you during registration based on your age), and for candidates under 18, a parent or guardian's authorization.
home.valueRespectBody: Respect for yourself, for others, for tradition.
home.valueExcellenceBody: Commit to progress, every single day.
home.valueCommunityBody: One club, one family, for life.
home.gallerySubtitle: Training, gradings and competitions through the season.
home.communitySubtitle: News, events and results — read and join the conversation.
home.offerGroupsBody: Weekly sessions in age-based groups, on a timetable your club sets.
home.offerEventsBody: Combat and technique events, a certificate for every competitor, and a member badge once your registration is paid.

about.title: About us
about.lead: Binh Dinh Gia is a Vietnamese martial art rooted in the Binh Dinh province — a school built on discipline, respect and patient work.
about.historyBody: Our clubs train children, juniors and adults at branches across the country, under the Ministry of Youth and Sports and the wilaya directorates. Every member is registered for the season, insured, and placed in the age category that matches their birth year.
about.disciplineBody: Binh Dinh Gia joins hand and foot techniques, forms (quyen), and controlled combat. Training builds coordination and stamina, but the first lesson is always self-control — the art is judged as much on bearing as on technique.
about.offerBody: Weekly sessions in training groups, technical gradings, regional competitions in both combat and technique, and certificates for every competitor. Members receive a club badge once their registration is paid.
about.joinBody: Registration is online. Fill in the form, upload the documents the club asks for, and download your registration sheet. Candidates under 18 need a parental authorisation; adults do not.
about.ctaCommunity: See what the club is up to
